text: ボックスに　あずけとる　ポケモンを　せいり　できるんや

structure.jp: ボックスに　あずけとる　ポケモンを
structure.en: the Pokémon you have deposited in the Boxes

structure.jp: せいり　できるんや

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ボックスに　あずけとる　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing tells you which thing it is. ボックスに　あずけとる　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon you have deposited in the Boxes'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the result of the action still holds. とる is the Kansai short form of ている. あずけとる = 'have deposited'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end gives the sentence an explaining tone, like 'you see'. んや is the Kansai form of んだ. できるんや = 'you can do it, you see'.
